findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

The hand sink was blocked. A cutting board has been placed over the top and is being used to hold a coffee maker. The cutting board and coffee maker were removed. Ensure that the hand sink is available for proper hand washing by providing a different set up for the coffee machine. Violation was corrected on site.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.14: A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES. 

A hand washing sign was provided to the club for posting at the bar hand sink.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: CORRECTED: Observed the ice machine deflector shield to be soiled with what appears to be mold. Clean the ice machine deflector shield. The member of the club wiped the ice machine deflector shield with a sanitized cloth to correct the violation during the inspection.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment: .1240) one light shield in basement kitchen is broken on corner.  Replace light shield.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
The basement kitchen sink faucet leaks when turned on.  Repair the faucet.

750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
There are chipped tiles in the basement kitchen floor.  Replace the tiles.

750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 37.1210a  The ceiling tiles in the men's restroom are not smooth.  Upon the next remodeling of the facilities, replace the tiles with ones that are smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment: 750.1240a   A light cover in the basement kitchen is broken.  Replace the cover.
